notes: Official blog publishedTime 2026-07-16T00:00:00Z used as release date. OpenRouter created 2026-07-08 and some trackers list 2026-07-09 — the API likely opened before the announcement post; official blog date wins per assignment rule (discrepancy recorded here). All six rows verified from the page's own machine-readable text: the benchmark values are embedded in the DOM as chart accessibility descriptions (vendor-authored), same extraction class as the grok-4-6 batch-1 DOM table. Page explicitly notes 'Competitor figures are drawn from the respective developers' published system cards or benchmark leaderboards' — competitor bars stay in notes, no comparison_cited rows (values are chart columns, not independent prose citations). Non-benchmark claims: 80 TPS serving speed, 2x token efficiency vs 'latest leading models', $2/$6 per 1M pricing, GB300 training fleet.
